title: `resource_link`
description: A tool result block that points at a resource URI instead of inlining its contents.
question: Does a resource link reach the agent as a reference it can follow?
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
why: Resource links are how a large result stays out of the context window until something asks for it. A framework that flattens the link to text keeps the URI as prose and loses the ability to fetch what it points at.

notes.openai-agents: OpenAI Agents SDK 0.23.1: the link is re-serialized as JSON inside a text item, retaining `uri`, `name` and `description`. Followable, but only after parsing text.
notes.pydantic-ai: Pydantic AI 2.54.0: only the URI is returned, as a bare string. The link is still followable, but its `name`, `description` and `mimeType` are gone.
notes.mastra: Mastra 2.2.0: a result without `structuredContent` comes back unchanged, resource_link intact with its `name`, `uri`, `description` and `mimeType`. For a result that carries `structuredContent`, every content block is dropped, resource links included; only the structured value reaches the agent.
notes.vercel_ai: Vercel AI SDK (@ai-sdk/mcp 2.0.73): execute resolves with the CallToolResult, so a caller reading a step's toolResults gets the resource link block intact. The adapter's toModelOutput converter maps only text and image blocks, so the model receives a resource link block as a text part holding the block's JSON (the uri, name and MIME type as characters). Boundary-dependent: kept at execute, flattened to text at model_output.
notes.strands: Strands Agents 1.59.0: `map_mcp_content_to_tool_result_content` handles text, image and embedded-resource blocks only. A `resource_link` block is dropped with a debug log, alone or beside other blocks.
notes.openai_agents_js: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS) 0.20.0: the model receives a resource link as its JSON serialization inside a text item; `MCPServer.callTool` itself returns the block intact.
notes.agno: Agno 3.1.2: a `resource_link` block becomes the text `[Unsupported content type: resource_link]` at both boundaries; the URI is lost.
notes.dspy: DSPy 3.4.0: with the default `result_mode="text"`, `Tool.acall` returns the resource link block as the MCP content object when the result has no text (direct: `y`). In a `dspy.ReAct` run the observation the model reads is that object's Python repr, `«name='linked.txt' uri='file:///fixtures/linked.txt' ...»` (react: `a`). When a result carries any text block, `_convert_mcp_tool_result` returns the text alone and drops the resource link block at both boundaries.
notes.langchain_js: LangChain.js (@langchain/mcp-adapters 2.0.1): a `resource_link` becomes a LangChain `file` block with `url`, `mimeType` and `metadata.{uri,name}`; its `description` is kept only in the app-side artifact.
notes.copilot_sdk: GitHub Copilot SDK 1.0.19 (Copilot runtime 1.0.95): depends on the boundary. `agent`: the `tool` message the provider receives is an empty string; the link's `uri`, `name` and `description` are dropped. `direct`: `session.rpc.tools.execute` returns the `resource_link` block whole.
notes.langchain4j: LangChain4j 1.22.0-beta32: The default `McpToolExecutor` result converter accepts text blocks only. Any `resource_link` block makes it throw `Unsupported content type: "resource_link"`: the direct executor raises it as a `RuntimeException`, and AiServices turns it into an error tool result the model reads in place of the block. A result with `structuredContent` never reads its blocks at all.
notes.google_adk_go: Google ADK (Go) 2.5.0 (go-sdk 1.8.0): `mcpTool.Run` returns `{"output": text}`, where `formatMCPContent` replaces the block with a placeholder line (`[MCP resource link: uri=..., mimeType=..., name=..., description=...]`), and the model receives that map as `FunctionResponse.response`. When the result also has `structuredContent`, as in the mixed result, `Run` returns `{"output": structuredContent}` and the block is dropped.
notes.ms_agent_framework_dotnet: Microsoft Agent Framework (.NET) 1.24.0 (ModelContextProtocol 2.2.0): `McpClientTool` has no `AIContent` for a `resource_link`, so it returns the whole `CallToolResult` as a JSON string at both boundaries. The link's fields are readable only by parsing that text.

summary: A resource_link is a pointer the agent is meant to be able to follow.
